items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-02-03
items.q: Joe Oliver had the job... he put me down there, Steve Lewis, Lewis Armstrong, Morris French... Old man Valto... was playing violin. And who was on piano? Well Steve... Must have been about four or five pieces.

ctx.x: Kind of skipping around a little bit. Did you ever work at Pete Lawrence? Yeah, I worked at Pete Lawrence.

When he was at Murray and Iterville. Yeah, I worked there. When I worked there in 19, about 17, 16, I believe in part of 17. How I come to work there, Joe Oliver had the job. Well Joe Oliver went with Ory's band at that time. See, now like Saturday nights and Sunday nights he played with Ory. Well he put me down there, Steve Lewis, Lewis Armstrong, Morris French, you heard of Morris French. Old man Valto, you heard of him, was playing violin. And who was on piano? Well who was in Joe Oliver's band when he was at Pete Lawrence? Old man Valto, he was playing violin.
